note: Nota sulle temperature DSC: i metodi dicono «The given values for the temperatures are onset and offset values for the corresponding heating and cooling processes», senza dire quale e' quale per ogni numero: i valori «at X °C» hanno tipo non_specificato, salvo dove il testo dice onset o minimo. CCDC: 891302-891305, 891307 e 891309 sono sei numeri e il supplementare elenca sei datablock (5-A, 5-D, 5-E, 7-C, D-1-A, rac-1), ma l'articolo non attribuisce i numeri alle forme: restano qui. Non estratti: i punti di fusione di neo-, muco- ed epi-inositolo e di 2-B (da altri lavori, tabella di rassegna), le miscele di 2-A e 2-B in DSC («two separate but barely resolved events, with onsets at about 359 and 364 °C», non attribuiti), i due idrati noti (cis-inositolo monoidrato TAZMOW, myo-inositolo MYTOLD01) senza eventi. Incoerenze: temperatura delle celle 293 K in Table 2 ma 25 (2) °C nei metodi; decomposizione di 2-A a 358 °C (3.3, Fig. 6, Table 1) e 355 °C (3.5); 5-C a 350 °C (Fig. 7) e 351 °C (Fig. 11, Table 1); «7-C ... is stable at 20 °C» (3.7) contro «At room temperature, 7-C slowly converts to 7-A over time»; la colonna Reference di Table 1 per L-1-A cita Jeffrey & Yeon per la struttura, ma le curve DSC di l-1 sono dichiarate uguali a quelle di d-1. citazioni: In the DSC, three further endothermic signals could be observed; the first sharp peak at 201 °C resulting from a phase transition to the high-temperature polymorph, (d-1-B), the second sharp peak at 245 °C from melting and a third broad signal between 281 and 337 °C resulting from decomposition.

This is because the high-temperature phase (d-1-B) is a rotator phase (see §3.9) and the major part of the melting process takes place at 201 °C, with only the translational order of the centres of mass of the molecules remaining.

5-D is a high-temperature polymorph that only exists above 57 °C and that converts to 5-E on cooling.

The crystal structures of 5-D and 5-E are very similar and share the same unit-cell parameters. The phase transition corresponds to the loss of the inversion symmetry to lower the space-group symmetry from Pbca, Z′ = 1 to one of its maximum subgroups P212121, Z′ = 2 (see overlay in Fig. 14 ▶).
These transformations are reversible: upon heating, 5-E changes back to 5-D at 57 °C, to 5-B at 156 °C and to 5-C at 215 °C, which finally shows a melting/decomposition point at 351 °C (Fig. 11 ▶).

citazioni: Repeated attempts to crystallize 2-B using crystallization experiments from methanol/water as indicated in the publication of Day et al. failed to reproduce the polymorph.

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: 50, 40 and 30 mg of 2-A in 3 ml water; vials in jars containing 10 ml methanol
citazioni: Vapour diffusion experiments were performed by dissolving 50, 40 and 30 mg samples of 2-A in 3 ml water using an ultrasonic bath.
The first set of solutions (containing 50, 40 and 30 mg dissolved in 3 ml water) were deposited without a lid into screw-top jars containing 10 ml methanol.
In each experiment, different ratios of 2-A and 2-B were obtained, but these experiments also failed to produce pure 2-B.
preparazioni.note: Miscele di 2-A e 2-B in rapporti diversi; 2-B puro mai ottenuto. Un secondo gruppo di fiale con coperchio forato da una cannula di 0.9 mm per rallentare la diffusione del metanolo.

preparazioni.rapporto_solido_solvente: scyllo-inositol in 3 ml water; portions of about 7 ml methanol added
citazioni: Additionally, antisolvent crystallization experiments were performed by dissolving scyllo-inositol in the same manner as for the vapour diffusion experiments. Afterwards, portions of about 7 ml methanol were added, at first fast to each of the first set of experiments using a syringe and then slowly by placing methanol carefully over the solution containing scyllo-inositol to yield a two-phase system.
In each experiment, different ratios of 2-A and 2-B were obtained, but these experiments also failed to produce pure 2-B.
preparazioni.note: Miscele di 2-A e 2-B, mai 2-B puro. Il metanolo e' aggiunto prima velocemente e poi lentamente in strato.

descrizioni.citazione: d-(+)-chiro- and l-(−)-chiro-inositol are enantiomers, and their crystal structures can be expected to be mirror images, with identical thermodynamic properties such as melting points.

descrizioni.testo: one of the only two chiral inositols (cannot pack in a space group with an inversion centre or a glide plane)
descrizioni.citazione: Because d-(+)- and l-(−)-chiro-inositol are the only inositols that are chiral, they are the only inositols that cannot pack in a space group with an inversion centre or a glide plane

proprieta.metodo: temperatura di fusione corretta per la simmetria molecolare (T m′), equazione (4) di Wei (1999)
proprieta.citazione: The only corrected melting point that can be calculated with the current data is that of rac-chiro-inositol (rac-1), for which T m′ = 221 °C.

proprieta.citazione: In contrast, the D 3d-symmetrical scyllo-inositol (σ = 6) exhibits neither a rotator phase nor any other phase transition up to its decomposition at 355 °C.

proprieta.metodo: numero di simmetria molecolare σ (simmetria C3v)
proprieta.citazione: Interestingly, the C 3v-symmetrical cis-inositol (σ = 3) has five different polymorphs, of which two are rotator phases, the first even at quite a low temperature (156 °C).

descrizioni.citazione: In 5-A, each molecule forms one intramolecular hydrogen bond and ten intermolecular hydrogen bonds (five as donors, five as acceptors; Fig. 13 ▶).

descrizioni.testo: one intramolecular hydrogen bond per molecule in 5-D and 5-E
descrizioni.citazione: In 5-D and 5-E, each molecule forms one intramolecular and ten intermolecular hydrogen bonds.
